name: Guardian Spirit Silvanshee (CR 2) — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Guardian Spirit Silvanshee (CR 2) from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's pages "Guardian Spirit Silvanshee (CR 4)", "Guardian Spirit Silvanshee (CR 6)" but are not part of the Guardian Spirit Silvanshee (CR 2) entry, which is unchanged.
